notes.title: Magical Squash :The VR Game that burns fat
notes.notes:
Magical Squash is a VR sports game  for use with the HTC Vive system. It is an improvement on normal squash games.

There are a lot of VR Sport games on the market but you’ll be glad you tried magical Squash

The only rule in this game is: hit the square. 

Check the handle and please make sure there is nothing around you that you might knock  over when you begin to play.

When you put on the VR helmet you will find yourself standing in the middle of a futuristic 3D space.

Grab the handle and begin to play squash, your score increase when you hit the blue square.

The sport tracking system is extremely accurate and will deliver an amazing exercise experience and at the same time challenge your skills.

There are two mode in the game. You can choose the zen mode to practice if you are a beginner before you step up to the stage mode.

Stage mode introduces a 30 sec time limit.You have to make sure to hit all the blue squares before time runs out I order to advance to the next stage.

The level of difficulty and the rules of the game are now different. Beside the blue square, there will be the pink ‘bomb’ square. If you hit it, it will blow up all the blue squares around it. Be careful! It’s not as easy as it sounds.

Hitting the yellow square will reduce the remaining time by 2 sec each time you hit it.

It is the same shape as the pink one ,but there are more of them - So good luck!

The soundtrack is also worth mentioning, you will really enjoy it.

Magical Squash is different from ordinary games, it will get you moving and combines healthy and enjoyable acgtivity.

It’s great for relieving stress. Exercising while playing, offers entertainment while getting fit.

Anyone  who is into VR sports games won’t want to miss it.
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943559/113b90ccaf14c7a4cbe9056e9af325a4a5ccc611.png[/img]

notes.title: Magical Squash：玩一天瘦一斤的VR运动游戏
notes.notes:
Magical Squash是一款适配于HTC Vive平台的运动类VR游戏，玩法灵感取材于传统壁球游戏。

虽然现在运动类VR游戏越来越多，但是Magical Squash是为数不多的玩法简单，却能让人玩到挥汗如雨的游戏。

游戏的内容只有两个字：打球。玩之前请务必确认好绑好手柄的手带，请务必确认周围没有障碍物……

戴上VR头盔之后，会进入一个充满未来感的三维立体空间。拿起手柄挥动球拍，将粉色的球击打到周围的空间墙上，击中蓝色方块就能得分~ 

Vive的运动追踪系统使游戏内的壁球校位非常精准，运动轨迹和击打感很真实。挥动球拍的轻重与角度影响着球速与回弹方向。这也赋予了游戏一定的难度和技巧性。

游戏里有两个模式。Zen模式类似于无限循环的单人训练模式，第一次玩可以选择这个模式练习~熟练之后再选择Stage模式。

Stage是限时闯关模式，还是有一定难度的。每关只有30秒，要在有限的时间里把空间里所有的蓝色方块都打掉。Combo数越高，击打蓝色方块得分越高，所以连击才是获得高分的关键哦~

除了蓝色得分方块，还有粉色方块和黄色方块。打中粉色方块可以“炸掉”周围的蓝色得分块，然而粉色的方块非常小，不太容易打中……

黄色方块是减时间的，打中之后会减少当前关卡的游戏时间2秒。虽然黄色方块和粉色方块一样大，但是数量非常多，所以Stage模式要想通关还是挺难的。

另外，Magical Squash的配乐也值得一提。充满科技电子风的音乐使游戏体验更流畅，空间沉浸感更真实。

与传统游戏不同，Magical Squash这类运动VR游戏能将四肢调动起来，把游戏、健康和快乐融合到了一起，在运动中体验纯粹的游戏乐趣。

对于平时学习工作压力大的同学来说这是一款放松心情的好游戏，在娱乐的过程中还能锻炼身体。每天玩上一个小时，就能锻炼出属于自己的麒麟臂~

要边玩游戏边健身的小伙伴，一定不能错过哦~
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943559/113b90ccaf14c7a4cbe9056e9af325a4a5ccc611.png[/img]

notes.title: Hi-tech sports VR game:Magical Squash
notes.notes:
Magical Squash is a sports VR game. The designer intends to give the player a full exercise experience during a short gameplay time.

When wearing the Vive helmet, the player will find themself standing in the middle of a futuristic 3D space.

Different from the ordinary squash game,  Magical Squash will let you enjoy hi-tech graphics and a great sound track.

ou will truly love it, when you hit the ball it is so real and so smooth! You will have a wonderful exercise experience  in a virtual environment.

The game has two mode: Zen mode and Stage mode.

Zen mode doesn’t have a time limit. It’s similar to one player infinite training mode with three difficulty levels. Asthe difficulty level increases, the blue squares will getting smaller.
This mode only records the latest combo of shots by the player. So try your best to predict the path of the ball andsoon you’ll be scoring points continuously.

In Stage mode the player competes with a limited time. You may choose three different stages to play. You will have to hit all the blue squares within the 30 second time limit to advance to the next stage.

The level of difficulty and the game rules are different. Alongside the blue square, there will be a pink ‘bomb’ square and a yellow ‘time’ square.

The remaining play time will be reducedif you hit the yellow square.If you hit the pink target squareyou will score extra points. The pink square will disappear after you hit it.

Within Stage mode  you can choose to play‘Marathon’ mode.. The stage will begin with a 15 sec time limit and each time you successfully advance to the next stage you will receivean extra 10 sec.

After you gachieve acombo,  a ‘5 more sec’ button will appear randomly on ablue square. You only have 5 sec to hit it before it disappears.

To get the high score, you will have to increase your play time first. This will challenge both your concentration and technique.

Last but not least, the score of the player will be recorded on the global ranking list where you can challenge the players throughout the whole world.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30943559/89748af5b609220dbbbd5b2c62c42a9330b5a0a3.jpg[/img]
